# Hello World PowerShell Script

Here's a simple Hello World script in PowerShell:

```powershell
Write-Host "Hello, World!"
```

## How to Run It

**Option 1: Run directly in PowerShell terminal**
```powershell
Write-Host "Hello, World!"
```

**Option 2: Save as a `.ps1` file and execute**
1. Save the code as `hello_world.ps1`
2. Run it in PowerShell:
```powershell
.\hello_world.ps1
```

---

## Slightly More Advanced Version

```powershell
# Hello World Script
# Author: Your Name
# Date: 2024

$message = "Hello, World!"
Write-Host $message -ForegroundColor Green

# Personalized greeting
$name = Read-Host "Enter your name"
Write-Host "Hello, $name! Welcome to PowerShell!" -ForegroundColor Cyan
```

---

## Useful Tips

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `Write-Host` | Prints text to the console |
| `Write-Output` | Sends output down the pipeline |
| `Read-Host` | Reads input from the user |
| `-ForegroundColor` | Changes the text color |

> **Note:** If you get an execution policy error, run:
> ```powershell
> Set-ExecutionPolicy -ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned -Scope CurrentUser
> ```
